basics.name: Nima Riahi Dehkordi
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer — Embedded AI & Perception
basics.summary: Software engineer with 6+ years taking ML models from research code to reliable, real-time software on real hardware — embedded SoCs, industrial 3D cameras and safety-critical systems. Strong in modern C++ and Python, model quantization and on-device deployment, and the testing and validation that make AI trustworthy in the field. Looking to apply this to robotics, medical technology, education and fintech.

work.name: CARIAD SE
work.summary: Deploying and validating a deep-learning trajectory-prediction model on a Qualcomm SoC (QNN/QNX) in a safety-critical, real-time stack, with C++20 components developed to ISO 26262 and ASPICE.
highlights: Contributed to the ONNX-to-QNN quantization pipeline that brought on-board inference down to 8 ms.
Improved mixed-precision quantization and masked normalization for the model, plus supporting tooling.
Built smoke tests, KPIs and an on-board evaluation suite for the model, with Databricks dashboards.
Owned recompute and deployment pipelines (DAGs) across x86 and embedded target boards.
Fixed and hardened pre-/post-processing and contributed to vehicle demos and visualization tooling.

work.name: Autonomous Reply
work.summary: Shadow-mode testing for a client's driving software: run a candidate function next to the live one on real data and capture the cases where they disagree.
highlights: Built a ROS 2 prototype with an intelligent edge-case trigger for targeted data collection.
Developed data-collection concepts (VAAFO) on AUTOSAR Adaptive.
Acted as agile coach for the team.

work.name: Ferchau Engineering, at SICK AG
work.summary: Embedded software for industrial 3D stereo and Time-of-Flight cameras used in automation and robotics.
highlights: Developed embedded applications and firmware features on Yocto-based embedded Linux.
Deployed lightweight real-time person detection on NVIDIA Jetson with TensorRT.
Wrote system tests and maintained CI/CD for the camera software.

work.name: Mercedes-Benz AG
work.summary: Camera-based perception research for vulnerable road users: deep metric learning for person re-identification, including two new benchmarks and uncertainty modelling.
